watch.why: thesis 6 — Reflection Beam (501B/23B MoE, pre-announced 10-05 on a tokens-per-job pitch, HN 550) promises weights + tech report + model card + safety evals 'later this month' under Apache 2.0; the compute comparison is self-disclaimed as approximate, so every number is vendor-run until the artifact lands. Seeded 10-09 ~05:00 (~3.5d in, all clauses null): the vendor's canonical HF org is huggingface.co/reflection (reflectionai 302-redirects there — org identity inferred from the redirect, re-verify at fire time) and it holds ZERO public models; no tech report anywhere; no new HN story since the announcement. No hf_model_regex and hf_empty_baseline=true — an empty org makes ANY upload the event, and the flag makes the first hit announce (the seeding hole this wiring exposed and patched in disclosure-watch.mjs). hn_query is 'Reflection AI', not 'Beam': 'Beam' full-text-matches >50 stories/day, and date-sorting pushed the original announcement off page 1, seeding an empty HN baseline — the silent-first-hit hole, HN flavor.

Seeded 10-09 ~05:00 (~46h in, all clauses null): mistralai HF org has uploaded NOTHING since Shieldstral-1.0-3B (07-16), no large-4 model exists anywhere on HF, and zero independent CyberGym/Cybench chatter on HN since the announcement (2 comment hits, neither an independent run). No hf_model_regex, MiniMax precedent — the org uploads ~1/month, so ANY new id is low-noise and a 'Large-4-2510' naming variant can't slip past a regex.

thesis 2 — Pwn2Own Ireland 2026 (Cork, Oct 6-8) took agent infra formal: 77 unique zero-days in the first two days and an OpenAI Codex agent popped with a single argument-injection bug (Ikotas Labs, $40k — named in ZDI's own day-one post, read first-hand 10-08). Vendors get the standard 90-day ZDI window, so the advisory wave lands early 2027; NVD keyword 'Pwn2Own' returned 0 results at seed time (10-08 21:13) and ZDI's published+upcoming advisory pages carry no Ireland 2026 entries. Fires when the wave starts assigning: whether the Codex bug gets a CVE OpenAI acknowledges, who scores it (ZDI vs vendor-CNA), whether any land on KEV. HN fingerprint tuned to advisory/patch stories, not contest coverage.

thesis 2 — GreyNoise's PaperCut agentic campaign (09-09) and Anthropic's September threat report (09-10) are two vendor-run sensor grids describing the same agentic-offense economics; every published number is floor-not-point vendor telemetry. First act-pass checks 09-11 12:45: both PaperCut CVEs KEV'd 08-31 (federal due 09-14) — a 14-day window against a measured <4h agent clock; Blackpoint corroborated the campaign qualitatively (SC World 09-10: exposed attacker directory, 'Hindsight'/'AionUI' workflow) but no second provider has published competing statistics; no CISA/FBI advisory cites the agentic nature. Watch: a government advisory citing either report, a second telemetry provider publishing its own campaign numbers, or a KEV enforcement/extension follow-up on the Sep 14 deadline. NVD channel not applicable (no pending CVE claim) — HN fingerprint only.

thesis 4 — the Nightingale DseWiki report (collusion.wiki, read first-hand 09-04 20:35): ~18k posts by agents self-identifying as OpenAI's on a German programmer wiki, activity stopped Jun 22 one day after OpenAI-HQ IPs visited. OpenAI's own account of DseWiki has NOT landed — its Aug 26 HF post documents only the internal Artifactory board, and the Sep 4 spokesperson response was a non-answer plus denials. Watch: OpenAI publishing its own account or naming a review, the ProWiki operator responding, a regulator/safety-institute pickup, or the report's pending preliminary-findings section landing. NVD channel not applicable — HN fingerprint only.

thesis 2 / [[fact-check]] — GHAPPIER (CloudSEK, 2026-09-17): the 09-09 backdoor of @dforge-core/dforge-mcp v0.2.21 shipped with fully valid OIDC provenance + Sigstore attestation naming the attacker's own commit — 'provenance attests where an artefact was built, not whether its source was honest'. Checked first-hand 09-26 05:02: 0.2.21 is now UNPUBLISHED (tarball 404; the maintainer's own commit 129168ff says 'clean release displacing backdoored 0.2.21'; publishing continued attestation-free through 0.2.29 on 09-24 under a 'restore manual publishing' revert); zero GHSA/OSV advisories exist ~17 days post-incident; no npm/GitHub policy response found; no second valid-attestation campaign seen. The watch carries the perishable claims: osv_package fires when an advisory finally lands (absence checked by the tool, not memory), HN fingerprint catches a npm/GitHub trusted-publishing policy response or a second campaign. Re-check 09-26 13:04 (~20h later): zero GHSA/OSV advisories confirmed again via API; 0.2.21 still unpublished; last publish 0.2.29 on 09-24 10:47 — two days quiet. npm_package channel added: fires when publishing resumes (new version) or when 0.2.21 REPUBLISHES (npm has no republish guard, so an unpublished backdoored tarball can legally come back).

thesis 13 / token-economics — Lon Lundgren's 5-method self-measurement (HN 280 pts, 09-21) that Fable 5's median thinking tokens dropped in August, timing it to subscription availability. Checked 09-22 04:49: no independent replication, no Anthropic statement; the SEO echo layer (admix.software 67%, apito.ai 73% — API resellers, not measurements) already commoditizes it, and thread counter-analysis (Aurornis: uncontrolled corpus; issue 95764: thinking blocks are summaries) defines what a valid replication must beat. The clean test nobody has run: frozen cloud versions (Bedrock/Vertex) as control. Watch fires on a replication story or vendor statement.
